name: The Handcuffed Woman
source:
The Handcuffed Woman is a game about Lucio Alvarez, a really sad policeman who found a woman handcuffed to a stop sign. What could go wrong? 

[From [url=https://arcusnoel.itch.io/the-handcuffed-woman]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《戴上手铐的女人》是一款关于卢西奥·阿尔瓦雷斯 (Lucio Alvarez) 的游戏，他是一位非常悲伤的警察，他发现一名妇女被铐在停车标志上。可能会出什么问题？

[来自[url=https://arcusnoel.itch.io/the-handcuffed-woman]itch.io[/url]]
